evals.name: older-consumer-minimum
evals.prompt: Our consumer declares Go 1.22 and uses Chronicle.Go v0.9.1 and Arc.Go v0.1.1. Can we add Fundamentals.Go v0.3.2 for a UUID concept and use the developer's newer toolchain to claim Go 1.22 support? Must we upgrade the other products' Fundamentals dependency?
evals.expected_output: All three pinned roots require Go 1.26. Resolve the incompatible minimum explicitly; the standalone concepts pin is not a required dependency upgrade for the other products.
assertions: Checks each tagged go.mod and refuses to claim Go 1.22 support: Fundamentals.Go v0.3.2 and Arc.Go v0.1.1 require Go 1.26, and Chronicle.Go v0.9.1 requires Go 1.26.0.
Does not silently raise go.mod or use an automatically newer toolchain as minimum-version evidence; requests an authorized compatibility choice.
States Chronicle.Go v0.9.1 and Arc.Go v0.1.1 require Fundamentals.Go v0.1.0, not v0.3.2; the independent concepts example pin is not a mandatory transitive upgrade.

evals.name: wrapped-concept-error-compatibility
evals.prompt: At Fundamentals.Go v0.3.2, concepts.Underlying rejects an invalid declaration. We plan to replace its error with fmt.Errorf using %v and compare the message in callers. Is that compatible? Show how to test the public error contract without depending on exact diagnostic text or claiming the marker enforces business validation.
evals.expected_output: Preserve ErrInvalidConcept and TypeError through deliberate wrapping; test errors.Is/errors.As and keep declaration recognition separate from business validation.
assertions: Preserves concepts.ErrInvalidConcept with errors.Is through %w wrapping instead of %v-only formatting or message equality.
Preserves the typed concepts.TypeError through errors.As, including useful declaration diagnostics, rather than replacing it with an unrelated sentinel.
Distinguishes Underlying declaration recognition and CheckJSON scalar-shape checking from business invariants; a ConceptValue marker is not automatic domain validation.

evals.name: named-uuid-wire-compatibility
evals.prompt: Define a named AuthorID based on Fundamentals.Go v0.3.2 concepts.UUID for a shared Arc.Go/Chronicle.Go payload. A proposed simplification removes forwarding methods, treats null as the zero UUID and uses .NET Guid byte order. Review wire compatibility and failure-atomic decoding at these tags.
evals.expected_output: A defined type needs explicit text/JSON forwarding codecs. Preserve canonical dashed string JSON, RFC byte order and the explicit null/zero policy, with failed decodes leaving the receiver unchanged.
assertions: Uses a defined type rather than an alias and explicitly forwards value text/JSON encoders and pointer decoders; defined types do not inherit UUID methods.
Preserves RFC/network-order bytes and lowercase dashed UUID string encoding instead of a JSON byte array or .NET Guid.ToByteArray layout.
Keeps zero as Guid.Empty but rejects JSON null for a UUID scalar; absence needs an explicit nullable representation, not a silent zero conversion.
Tests text, JSON, map-key round trips and unchanged receiver state on invalid decoding, not only the compile-time Concept marker.
